meta.name: The Sparks Report — business programs and maker apps
meta.source: Added Nov 19, 2026; every site opened and confirmed live that day

added: IVMF Entrepreneurship Programs (EBV, V-WISE, Boots to Business and more)
log.note: Business programs added for the new “Help for my business” mode. Bunker Labs' old address now forwards to IVMF, so it is covered by the IVMF entry.

maker_note: SmartPlay AI · Veteran Owned and Developed 🇺🇸 · smartplayapps.com. Listed separately so you always know which apps are ours.

apps.name: SmartPlay Caddie
apps.what: A voice-first AI golf caddie: spoken club picks, targets and GPS distances, plus swing feedback, on phone, tablet and watch.
apps.status: Live on the App Store and Google Play.

apps.name: SmartPump
apps.what: An AI strength coach that plans each workout from your last session, shows every exercise, and counts reps from videos of your sets.
apps.status: Android beta. Request access; people are let in a few at a time.

apps.name: SmartManage
apps.what: A work and life assistant: talk to Roger, an AI chief of staff who organizes your tasks, calendar, contacts, bills and email drafts.
apps.status: Beta by request; new users are let in a few at a time.

orgs.name: SBA Veterans Business Outreach Centers (VBOC)
orgs.services: Workshops, one-on-one counseling and mentoring for veterans, service members and military spouses starting or growing a small business. Find the center for your region.
orgs.notes: Run by the U.S. Small Business Administration.

orgs.name: SBA Veteran Small Business Certification (VetCert)
orgs.services: SBA certification for veteran-owned (VOSB) and service-disabled veteran-owned (SDVOSB) small businesses, used to compete for federal contracts set aside for them.
orgs.notes: Apply online at the SBA certification site.

orgs.name: IVMF Entrepreneurship Programs (EBV, V-WISE, Boots to Business and more)
orgs.services: Syracuse University's Institute for Veterans and Military Families runs programs by stage: Boots to Business and STRIVE (idea); EBV, Military Founders Lab and V-WISE (startup); EBV Accelerate, Veteran EDGE and CEOcircle (growth). The D'Aniello Family Foundation Acceleration Challenge offers workshops and eligibility for up to $10,000 in grant funding.
orgs.notes: EBV has cohorts for military family members (EBV-F) and Wounded Warrior Project alumni (EBV-WWP). V-WISE is for women veterans and military spouses. Bunker Labs' old address now forwards here.

orgs.name: APEX Accelerators
orgs.services: No-cost help for small businesses that want to sell to the government: registrations, finding bids and preparing proposals. Formerly called PTACs.
orgs.notes: Find the office nearest you on the site.

orgs.name: Hivers & Strivers
orgs.services: Investment firm that backs early-stage companies founded by U.S. military veterans.
orgs.notes: Equity investors, not grants. Best fit once you have a product and early traction.

orgs.name: Warrior Rising
orgs.services: Nonprofit supporting veteran founders with training, mentorship, peer connections, events and grant funding.

orgs.name: SCORE
orgs.services: Free, private guidance from experienced volunteer mentors for anyone launching, running or growing a small business in the U.S.
orgs.notes: Open to everyone, not only veterans.
